title: Delete the pre-message-rewrite backup branch once the rewrite is settled
description:
Local branch backup/pre-message-rewrite-20261126-1009 holds main as it
was before the commit-message rewrite of 2026-11-26 (bead mimid-4yu4).
It is local only and has no upstream.

Keep it until the rewritten history has been pushed and nobody wants a
message restored from the old copy. Then delete it.

Mark's call, not an agent's: it is the only copy of the pre-rewrite
messages. Deleting it is unrecoverable once main is force-pushed over
the old history.

    git branch -D backup/pre-message-rewrite-20261126-1009
